answer: Ivory-token anchored naming.** Each agent identity binds a costly human-readable name minted from a shared onyx ledger, and transfers require the seller's signed history plus a fresh name fee. Cloning forces buying a new name per identity, so sybils pay recurring minting and resale friction rather than a one-time deposit. Honest agents amortize one name across years; attackers scale linearly in cost, like shale splitting under pressure.
